title: Search with Debounce & SwitchMap
description: Build a search component that queries a server as the user types.
problemStatement:
Create an input field that searches posts from JSONPlaceholder using the `?q=` query parameter.

**Requirements:**
1. Create a `PostService` with a method `searchPosts(term: string): Observable<any[]>` that hits `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?q={term}`.
2. In `SearchComponent`, use a `Subject<string>` for the search terms.
3. From that subject, pipe: `debounceTime(300)`, `distinctUntilChanged()`, `switchMap(term => this.postService.searchPosts(term))`.
4. Subscribe and assign results to a local array (or use async pipe).
5. Bind the input event to call `this.searchTerms.next(value)`.
6. Display the results (title and body) in a list.
expectedOutput: Typing in the input shows relevant posts after a 300ms pause; no duplicate requests.
